summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting Amendment No. 1 to a prospectus supplement under its May 8, 2026 At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities, Inc. The amendment increases the maximum Placement Shares issuable under the at-the-market program by an additional aggregate $8,990,537. Sales occur under the company's Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-294938), effective April 16, 2026. Thompson Hine LLP's legality opinion is filed as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine shelf takedown capacity increase, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and Nasdaq price pressure.
